items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: And by the way, the first job I ever played in my life, I played it with Lewis and George Nelson.

ctx.x: Did you say Dr. Nelson played too, or was it-

Well, I tell you what he used to do. He didn't play, he didn't say, I wouldn't say he played in a band, but this is what he would do sometimes when the band was rehearsing. He'd pick up his cornet and he'd play a few numbers. And then I remember there was a time out there whenever these different organizations, the Little Cornerstone, the Masonics was Little Cornerstone, Dr. Nelson was the one who blew the tables with his cornet. He always did do that out there.

I never did get to talk to him much. He was sick in recent years and deaf and all, I believe. Well, he was a very, very nice old man. And he was a good doctor and a good musician. His wife was a good musician. Very well known.
